notes: GAAP. Governmental receipts/disbursements from p5 Total Governmental Funds column; business-type from p8-9 Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds, Total column (p9). Business-type totals are computed (operating + nonoperating); interest expense (20,852) and loan administration fees (887) recorded as positive disbursements. Business-type roll-forward: 3,547,031 + 2,051,313 - 1,775,258 - 136,775 = 3,686,311. Governmental: 2,141,655 + 1,790,239 - 2,116,999 + 136,775 = 1,951,670. ending_cash 1,093,112 is Cash and cash equivalents only from the governmental funds balance sheet (p4); CDs 1,094,131 and county treasurer cash 22,695 not included. beginning_cash not shown. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) Total primary government column. General Fund detail: the Combining Statement of General Fund Departments (pp19-20) is the more detailed schedule so it is recorded by department (budget_final null; the General Fund budget schedule on p14 is not recorded to avoid double counting: budget 2,270,175 resources, 2,390,513 appropriations, actual 1,299,097/1,297,040 on budget basis). Street and Airport budget schedules (pp15-16) are on budgetary basis and differ from GAAP statement (Street revenues 318,094 vs 323,234; Airport expenditures 176,500 vs 189,610; reconciled on p17). No budget schedules exist in the PDF for business-type funds; per-fund business-type lines are taken from the proprietary statement of revenues, expenses (pp8-9), with nonoperating items included in each fund's totals and fund transfers as other financing. Nonmajor combining schedule (p18) has CDBG and Hospital Bond Sinking only. Department transfers on p19-20 net to 19,771 (General fund net transfers). Statement of cash flows proprietary (pp10-11) total column used (pp12-13, added by the v7 re-trim, are its reconciliation of operating income to operating cash flows; nothing new to record): noncapital financing is the transfers line (no subtotal printed). Read pages 1-20 of 20. Business-type object lines (p9 total column) are split by fund column: Golf and RV Park portions as culture/recreation, the rest utilities (split_from).
